newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Heartport raised by Cowen.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Heartport raised by Cowen.

text.p: -- Cowen said it upgraded Heartport Inc to strong buy from buy.
-- The analyst was not available for details.
-- Reached later, analyst Ann Pluemer Barber cited a "buzz" in the marketplace that minimally invasive surgery was being adopted more quickly than anticipated.

-- She also said Heartport's gaining U.S. Food and Drug Administration marketing approval for its surgery system in October came sooner than expected, and the company is training more surgical teams than previously expected.
-- She raised her 1997 sales estimate for the company to $15 million from $9.5 million.
